Each skill keeps its `SKILL.md`, its `REFERENCES.md` where it has one, and its `references/*.md` where it has one.

What LuminosiTS does with it: **inspired by**. Nothing here is copied into a `lumin-*` skill or a package as written. The motion set is distilled into `lumin-motion` in Lumin's own terms (TSL, the scene document and the `lumin` commands); the design audit pair is distilled into `lumin-ui`; the material and lighting skills are port candidates for D3, D4 and D6, and `LEDGER.md` beside this file records each one with the constraint that stops a straight port. The skills name a renderer Lumin no longer uses (three.js r169 and later on WebGL), and third-party products and brands; none of that travels.
